description: Architected and launched Trossen Cloud, a greenfield MLOps SaaS platform, enabling users to fine-tune LLMs on custom datasets and manage models, training jobs, and dataset pipelines end-to-end.

Engineered backend services for model management and job orchestration using FastAPI and Pydantic; unified the datasets and models APIs, eliminating duplicated logic and reducing endpoint surface area by 30%.
Owned the complete frontend as sole engineer, translating self-authored Figma designs into a production React + TypeScript (Vite) app with Zod schema validation and Tailwind CSS styling.
Provisioned full AWS infrastructure (EC2, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, WAF, SNS, S3, CloudFront) using Terraform IaC and Docker; deployed from local dev to production with automated CI/CD.
Designed and shipped a full-stack LMS serving 20+ departments and 500+ users with Django, React, and PostgreSQL on AWS, featuring RBAC, RESTful APIs, and a responsive multi-role UI.
Boosted data accuracy by 95% by building a dynamic query interface with advanced filtering, optimized schemas, and real-time D3.js analytics dashboards replacing manual reporting workflows.
Migrated 30 years of legacy data (~8M records) into the new LMS via automated ETL pipelines (Python/Pandas, SQL); deployed to AWS with GitHub Actions CI/CD achieving zero-downtime rollout.

Grew digital reach by 20% by handling every stage of video production — from on-location shooting and photography to motion graphics and final reel delivery — for campus events and promotional campaigns using Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
Maintained brand consistency across all deliverables by producing visual content for social media and web platforms aligned with university identity guidelines.
Shortened project delivery timelines by coordinating video production workflows across marketing and design teams in Jira, cutting turnaround time between shoots, edits, and publishing.
